observed: AX setValue on egui name/numeric creation fields produced no change. Direct focus/key input was used instead.
status: Retained; no source fix or parity claim inferred.

observed: Rapid direct click/type batch left point7 equal to point6 and point10 Y=1.00 instead of1.60. Close rejected a degenerate edge, leaving zero pieces.
resolution: Escape deliberately cancelled rejected draft; unchanged frozen coordinates reentered with per-field focus observation, paste, exact readback, then Add point.

observed: First numeric AX parser included role text and produced NaN. The check stopped before staging a point. A retained function closure then still used the old parser.
resolution: Fresh helper names with a strict role/value parser and assert-based parser self-check. This was an evaluator defect, not a garment or product failure.

observed: AX click/paste batch did not focus or rename the second creation field.
resolution: Visible coordinate click held100ms established focus, then paste/Tab and readback confirmed Harbor back.

observed: With a piece selected, first100-child AX cap hid seam6 onward and caused a deliberate check stop.
resolution: Native Select/edit, blank canvas deselection, and return to Sew exposed the complete list. Seam6 and all8 final pairs were correct; no seam was retried or changed.

observed: A first whole-document equality assertion after Undo failed because the revision advanced16→18. The geometry and all other serialized construction matched exactly.
resolution: Independent final checker asserts expected monotonic16/17/18/19/20 revisions and exact equality of every other serialized field. The frozen geometry and physical limits were never changed.

observed: Original CUA screenshot payloads were JPEG bytes saved under private .png filenames. First candidate PNG-signature check stopped.
resolution: Original private bytes retained. Public candidate has only correctly named raw-screenshots/*.jpg copies with byte-identical SHA256, actual MIME/header checks and explicit source/public mapping. Generated PNG variants from the superseded packaging attempt are omitted.
